gallery.eyebrow: A little space for your music
gallery.heading: Quietly, beautifully musical.
gallery.intro: Warm surfaces, soft violet, room to breathe. Meet the small details that will shape your Musiclatte space.
gallery.foundationNote: A quiet palette and clear type, leaving the spotlight to your music.
gallery.actionNote: Give the main action a clear voice. Try a button to see its response.
gallery.longAction: Add all music in the selected folder to the current playlist
gallery.feedbackIdle: Your action feedback will appear here.
gallery.feedbackDone: Action received. Your music stays unchanged.
gallery.iconNote: Small in appearance, comfortable to press. Every icon has an accessible name.
gallery.fieldNote: Labels stay visible. Help and errors stay close to the field.
gallery.help: Enter the name you use on your music server. Longer guidance stays readable without hiding any information.
gallery.fieldError: We could not find that name. Check the spelling and enter it again.
gallery.stateNote: A clear next step, through waiting, empty spaces, and errors.
gallery.loadingDescription: Your library is on its way. The music you are listening to keeps playing.
gallery.emptyDescription: Choose another folder to find something you love.
gallery.errorTitle: This folder could not be loaded
gallery.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again. Music already loaded is still available.
gallery.recoveredDescription: Your music is ready to explore again.
gallery.artwork: A little face for your music
gallery.artworkNote: The same space, even when a cover is loading or missing.
gallery.coverAlt: A little afternoon playlist album cover
gallery.footer: Real shared components · Development preview only
login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Sign in to your music space.
login.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.description: Choose a playlist to see its songs or start listening in order.
playlists.loadingHelp: Your playlists are on their way. Current playback is unchanged.
playlists.emptyHelp: Create a playlist here, then add music whenever you are ready.
playlists.detailEmptyHelp: Add songs in Musiclatte, then return here to listen in order.
playlists.notFoundHelp: This playlist was removed or is no longer available. Return to your playlists.
playlists.deniedHelp: Your account cannot open this playlist. Return to a playlist you can access.
playlists.unavailableHelp: Playlists are not available for this account right now.
playlists.nameHelp: Use 1–255 characters. Spaces at the beginning and end are removed; symbols are kept.
playlists.nameInvalid: Check the name and try again.
playlists.deleteImpact: Only this playlist is deleted. Its songs and audio files are kept.
playlists.conflict: This playlist changed elsewhere. The latest version is shown behind this dialog.
playlists.outcomeUnknown: The result could not be confirmed. Refresh the playlist before trying again.
playlists.removeContext: Remove {title} at position {position} from this playlist? The song and audio file are kept.
playlists.editConflict: This playlist changed elsewhere. The latest version is shown below.
settings.languageHelp: Changing language keeps your current page and sign-in.
status.unavailableHelp: There is no available feature at this address.
status.capability: Some feature information is unavailable. Your account and language settings are still available.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
error.csrf_rejected: Your sign-in changed. Please try again.
error.invalid_request: Check your details and try again.
error.token_auth_unsupported: This server does not support this sign-in method. Contact your server administrator.
error.upstream_unavailable: Cannot reach the server. Please try again shortly.
error.storage_unavailable: Cannot check your session. Please try again shortly.
error.internal_error: Could not complete your request. Please try again.
error.upstream_incompatible: The music server API version is incompatible.
error.conflict: This playlist changed. Refresh it before trying again.
error.outcome_unknown: The result could not be confirmed. Refresh before trying again.
music.title: Music
music.eyebrow: A little space for your music
music.description: Explore your folders or find a favorite.
music.loadingHelp: Loading music at your current location.
music.notFoundHelp: This item is missing or unavailable. Choose another folder.
music.noMatchesHelp: Try another search term or explore all music.
music.noDetails: No linked artist or album information.
player.error.play_not_allowed: Playback did not start. Press play to try again.
player.error.media_unavailable: This song could not be played. Try another song.
player.random.empty: No random songs were returned. Your queue is unchanged.
player.random.error: Random songs are temporarily unavailable. Your queue is unchanged.
selection.pickerHelp: Choose an editable playlist. Songs are added in their source order.
selection.targetsError: Could not load editable playlists. Close and try again.
selection.targetChanged: This playlist is no longer editable. Choose another playlist.
selection.noTargets: No editable playlists are available yet.
selection.partial: Added: {applied}. Failed: {failed}. Not attempted: {unattempted}. Those songs remain selected.
favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.description: Songs you saved, in the order returned by your music server.
favorites.updateError: Could not update this favorite. The previous state was restored.
favorites.loadingHelp: Your saved songs will stay in the order from your music server.
favorites.emptyHelp: Use the star action on any song to save it here.
favorites.deniedHelp: This account is not allowed to read or update favorite songs.
favorites.unavailableHelp: Favorite songs are not available on this server right now.
probe.title: Audio transport probe
probe.instructions: Use the native controls to play, pause, and seek the authenticated sample.
imports.title: Import music
imports.intro: Add YouTube links to your music library.
imports.rights: Only import music you own or have permission to download.
imports.urlHelp: Paste one video link per line. Links copied from a mix or playlist import only the selected video. Press Ctrl/⌘ + Enter to submit.
imports.invalid: Enter an HTTPS YouTube video link. Playlist or channel URLs without a selected video are not supported.
imports.cancelHelp: Songs already published will not be deleted.
imports.registeringHelp: File saved. Waiting for registration in the music library.
imports.emptyHelp: Paste links above to follow their progress here.
imports.accepted: Request accepted. Follow each item for completion.
imports.cancelAccepted: Cancellation accepted. Items show Cancelled once work has stopped.
imports.deniedHelp: This account does not have permission to import music.
imports.unavailableHelp: You can keep listening. Try imports again shortly.
imports.unsupportedHelp: Music imports are not available on this server.
imports.failure.invalid_file_key: Could not verify a safe storage location.
imports.failure.download_failed: Download failed. You can retry this item.
imports.failure.process_cleanup_failed: Could not safely finish audio processing.
imports.failure.publish_failed: Could not save the audio file.
imports.failure.publish_uncertain: Could not confirm whether the file was saved.
imports.failure.worker_interrupted: The worker stopped. You can retry this item.
recent.title: Recent downloads
recent.description: Listen to recent imports and collect them in a playlist.
recent.invalid: Enter valid dates with the through date on or after the from date.
recent.newHelp: Refresh the list while keeping your selected songs.
recent.errorHelp: Loaded results, selections and playback are kept. Try again.
recent.deniedHelp: Return to music or settings to see available features.
recent.emptyHelp: Choose another period or browse your music.
recent.registeringHelp: The file is saved. Selection and playback are available after registration.
recent.missingHelp: The file moved or is inaccessible. Check again after the library is restored.
recent.selection: Loaded ready songs only · not all results
recent.allLoaded: All downloads in this period are loaded.
engine.title: Download engine
engine.description: Manage yt-dlp nightly for new music imports.
engine.help.candidate_pending_validation: The candidate is not active yet. It will be used for new imports only after validation on the next eligible source.
engine.help.update_failed: Could not check for a new version. The active version and saved music are preserved. Check again or restore an available previous version.
engine.help.validation_failed: The candidate failed source validation, so the active version was kept. Check again or restore an available previous version.
engine.unavailableHelp: The worker may be offline, or the engine may need a check or recovery. Refresh the status or request an available recovery below. Saved music remains playable.
engine.sending: Sending the request. Please wait before submitting again.
engine.checkAccepted: Check requested. This does not mean the update is complete. Watching for progress.
engine.restoreAccepted: Restore requested. Watching for the active version to change.
engine.checkingHelp: The status will refresh when the check finishes. Duplicate actions are unavailable while checking.
engine.checkHelp: Request a check for a new nightly version. Reading status does not trigger an update.
engine.noPrevious: There is no previous version to restore yet.
engine.restoreUnavailable: A previous version exists, but recovery is temporarily unavailable. Refresh the status shortly. Running imports and saved music playback continue.
engine.restoreHelp: The restored version applies to the next import job. Running imports and saved music playback continue.
metadata.intro: Only changed fields are saved. The original file is kept for recovery.
metadata.title: Title
metadata.yearHelp: Use a four-digit year, for example 2026.
metadata.trackHelp: Enter a track number or number/total, for example 3 or 3/12.
metadata.invalid: Check this value. To remove it, use the Clear button.
metadata.coverHelp: JPEG/PNG, up to 8 MiB and 16 megapixels. Only the selected front cover changes.
metadata.invalidCover: Check the JPEG/PNG image size and format.
metadata.coverSelection: Choose the front cover to change.
metadata.languageHelp: Three-letter language code: kor, eng, or und (unspecified). Independent of the interface language.
metadata.failed: The request could not be completed. Your edits are preserved.
metadata.uncertain: The save result is unknown. Check history or resend the same request.
metadata.saving: Saving continues. Check the result in history.
metadata.pendingHelp: File saving and library verification are separate. Existing music information may remain visible temporarily.
metadata.recoveryHelp: Check current music information and review the result in job history.
metadata.error.revision_conflict: The file changed elsewhere. Check current music information.
metadata.error.claimed_by_other: Another task has reserved this track. Try again after its reservation ends.
metadata.error.unsupported_format: This format does not support editing.
metadata.error.invalid_metadata: Check the music information you entered.
metadata.error.ambiguous_selector: Choose the cover or lyrics entry to change.
metadata.error.backup_failed: The original could not be backed up; no save was made.
metadata.error.prepare_failed: The changes could not be prepared.
metadata.error.write_failed: The file could not be saved.
metadata.error.write_uncertain: The file save outcome needs verification.
metadata.error.reflection_unavailable: Waiting to verify the saved file in the library.
metadata.error.reflection_mismatch: The file was saved, but the library still shows previous information.
metadata.error.reference_conflict: Existing song references could not be verified.
metadata.error.worker_interrupted: The save worker stopped. Check the current status.
metadata.readFailed: Edit history could not be loaded. Try again.
metadata.bulkFrames: Edit cover and lyrics one song at a time. Their frame selectors can differ.
metadata.bulkLimit: Edit up to 64 unique songs at a time. Split larger selections explicitly.
metadata.libraryGroups: Choose one library group. Other groups remain selected for a separate edit.
metadata.retryIntro: Only failed songs that have not been saved are retried. Review current values and the original change again.
metadata.retryPrepareFailed: Current values could not be verified. Close this review, reload the job and try again.
metadata.recheckHelp: Only library lookup and references are checked; the file is not written again.
metadata.conflictIntro: Compare the submitted change with the current file. Editing starts from current values without applying the previous change.
metadata.restoreIntro: The entire original file is restored, undoing all changes since this backup. If the current file changes, review it again.
metadata.noDifference: No visible tag differences. The entire file will still be restored to the selected original.
metadata.restorePreviewFailed: The original comparison is not ready. Reload shortly; the backup remains available.
metadata.recoveryConflict: The file changed again. Reload and compare the current values before continuing.
metadata.recoveryDenied: You do not have permission, or the original is unavailable.
metadata.restorePending: Restore requested. Check history until both the file restore and library verification finish.
metadata.changedCover: Cover artwork will also change to the original.
scan.title: Media scan
scan.description: Update your library with changes in music folders.
scan.intervalHelp: Default: 360 minutes (6 hours). Choose 15–10,080 minutes (7 days).
scan.invalid: Enter a whole number from 15 to 10,080.
scan.serverHelp: Applies to this server and runs even when your browser is closed.
scan.permissionLost: Automatic scans stopped after a permission change. Configure again with an administrator account.
scan.lastFailed: The last automatic scan request failed. It will retry at the next scheduled time.
scan.adminOnly: Media scanning and automatic scan settings are available to administrator accounts.
error.snapshot_expired: This list has expired. Refresh to start a new list.
error.snapshot_scope_changed: Your access has changed. Reload the list.
error.snapshot_capacity: A new list is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.help: Allow an automation client to work on selected libraries. Signing out does not revoke its tokens.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.nameError: Enter a name of 1–120 characters without control characters.
tokens.scopeHelp: Reading is required. Enable metadata editing before lyrics editing.
tokens.selectionError: Select at least one library and a valid permission combination.
tokens.once: This is the only time the full token is shown. Save it securely before hiding it.
tokens.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the token above and copy it manually.
tokens.unknownHelp: The token may have been created, but its secret was not received. Refresh the list, identify it by name and creation time, and revoke it before creating a replacement.
tokens.acknowledge: I checked the list; prepare a new token
tokens.emptyHelp: Create a token when you connect an automation client.
tokens.confirmHelp: This token will no longer authorize new requests. Already accepted work can finish safely.
tokens.loadingHelp: Checking your libraries and issued tokens.
tokens.unavailableHelp: Check the server status and try again.
tokens.denied: You do not have permission to manage automation tokens.
curation.title: Music curation
curation.description: Review required information and find missing optional information.
curation.independent: Required review and optional information are independent.
curation.optionalActive: Optional information is being enriched. Required review stays unchanged.
curation.workPending: Waiting for file work or library updates.
curation.snapshotHelp: This list reflects its retrieval time. Refresh starts a new list with current information.
curation.inventoryPending: Library verification is not finished. Current counts may not include every track.
curation.emptyHelp: Change the filters or refresh the list.
curation.unavailableHelp: Curation is unavailable. You can continue browsing your music.
